description: Defines a Rectangle class with geometric operations such as combine, intersection, overlaps, and containment checks.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with position (x, y) and size (w, h), providing geometric operations.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are equal.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two rectangles are not equal.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines two rectangles to form the minimal rectangle enclosing both.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two rectangles.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Returns the union of two rectangles.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a point (tx, ty) is inside the rectangle.
